description: International road safety comparisons, annual (current and archived) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics; publisher not stated. Members: Archived International Road Safety Comparisons, Annual; International Road Safety Comparisons. Example entry: Archived International Road Safety Comparisons, Annual. Coverage is Australia, 1990 to 2023; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as archived and current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-09-12. Files and pages listed: HTML, PDF (3 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
